subject: Shiny app hosted on Glimmer not responding to change of data

messages.author: b814cc64234fc767
messages.subject: Shiny app hosted on Glimmer not responding to change of data
parts:
Dear Shiny folks,

I'm been working on a Shiny app that pull tweets containing a same hashtag together for some simple analysis. Right now it is deployed on the RStudio glimmer server and many colleagues have found it quite useful for events like an academic conference. Link here: http://glimmer.rstudio.com/bodong/aera13/

However, I'm experiencing some wired problem that's out of my knowledge, and I couldn't get any answer from Google either. The problem is (as you can see from the link above) the app stopped updating after April 27, even if the tweets have been growing every hour. I've checked tweet data which are automatically updated every hour, and didn't find any problem. But weirdly the application will not reflect the change of data. I wonder whether there's a way to restart an already deployed Shiny app on Glimmer. Any advice will be highly appreciated.

Thanks,
Bodong

messages.author: c6ca7877bef91eef
messages.subject: Re: Shiny app hosted on Glimmer not responding to change of data
parts: Just add a restart.txt file to your app directory and just touch it anytime you want your app to restart.
